info.name: Appealable Issues Unique User Metrics API

items.docs: Log unique user metrics events for analytics tracking. Accepts multiple events in a single batch operation and buffers them for asynchronous processing by a background job. This endpoint is used for tracking unique user interactions with MHV Portal features to provide opt-out-free analytics that are more accurate than Google Analytics.
